34:1: Praise is to Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. And in the Hereafter praise is also to Him. He is the Possessor of judgment and wisdom, All-Aware of everything.
34:2: He knows what enters the earth and what comes out from it, what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. He is the Most Merciful, the Most Forgiving.
34:3: Those who disbelieve said: 'The Hour will not come to us.' Say: 'Yes, by my Rabb, it will surely come to you; He is the Knower of the unseen.' The weight of an atom in the heavens and in the earth does not escape Him; nor is there anything smaller than this or greater that is not in a clear book.
34:4: It is so that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. For those, there is forgiveness and a generous provision.
34:5: As for those who strive against Our verses, for them there is a painful punishment.
34:6: Those who were given knowledge see that what has been revealed to you from your Rabb is the truth and that it guides to the path of the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.
34:7: Those who disbelieve said: Shall we show you a man who informs you that when you are completely torn to pieces, you will surely be in a new creation?
34:8: Did he fabricate a lie against Allah, or is there a madness in him? Rather, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are in punishment and far error.
34:9: Did they not look at the heaven and the earth that are before them and behind them? If We will, We can cause the earth to swallow them or cause pieces from the heaven to fall upon them. Surely in this is a sign for every servant who turns.
34:10: And by oath, We gave David a favor belonging to Us: O mountains, glorify along with him, and the birds as well; and We softened iron for him.
34:11: Make wide coats of mail and measure its weave. And do righteous deeds. Surely I am the All-Seeing of what you do.
34:12: And for Solomon [We subjected] the wind; its morning journey was a month, and its evening return was a month. And We made the spring of molten copper flow for him. And of the jinn were those who worked before him by permission of his Rabb. And whoever of them swerves from Our command, We make him taste of the punishment of the blazing fire.
34:13: They made for him whatever he willed of sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and immovable cooking pots. Work, O family of David, in gratitude! And few of My servants are grateful.
34:14: When We decreed death upon him, nothing indicated his death to them except a creature of the earth, an animal eating his staff. When he fell, the jinn realized that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in the humiliating punishment.
34:15: By oath, there was for the people of Saba in their dwelling places a sign: two gardens on the right and on the left. Eat from the provision of your Rabb and be grateful to Him.
34:16: But they turned away, whereupon We sent upon them the flood of Arim and replaced their two gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisk trees, and a few cedar trees.
34:17: Thus We punished them because of their disbelief. And do We punish anyone except the one who is very ungrateful?
34:18: And We placed between them and the cities We had blessed visible cities, and We determined the travel therein: Travel through them by night and by day in safety.
34:19: They said: Our Rabb, make distant the stages between our journeys. Thus they wronged themselves, so We dispersed them completely. Surely in this are signs for everyone who is very patient and very grateful.
34:20: And by oath, Iblis proved his assumption about them true, so they followed him, except for a group of the believers.
34:21: And he had no power over them, except that We might distinguish the one who believes in the Hereafter from the one who is in doubt concerning it; and your Rabb is Watcher over all things.
34:22: Say: Call upon those whom you claimed besides Allah; they do not possess the weight of an atom in the heavens or in the earth, and they have no share in either of them, and for Him there is no helper from among them.
34:23: Intercession does not benefit with Him, except for those whom He has permitted. Until, when fear is removed from their hearts, they say: What did your Rabb say? They say: The truth. And He is the Most High, the Grand.
34:24: Say: Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth? Say: Allah. And surely, either we or you are upon guidance or in clear error.
34:25: Say: You will not be asked about the crimes we committed, nor will we be asked about what you do.
34:26: Say: Our Rabb will gather us together, then He will judge between us in truth; and He is the Judge, the All-Knowing.
34:27: Say: Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. By no means! Rather, He is Allah, the Aziz, the Hakim.
34:28: And We have not sent you except to all mankind as a bringer of glad tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
34:29: And they say: When is this promise, if you are truthful?
34:30: Say: For you is an appointed day from which you can neither delay for an hour nor precede.
34:31: Those who disbelieve said: We will never believe in this Quran, nor in the books before it. If you could but see the wrongdoers stopped before their Rabb! They cast words back and forth at one another; those who were powerless say to those who were arrogant: If not for you, we would have been believers.
34:32: Those who were arrogant said to those who were weakened: Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? No, rather you were criminals.
34:33: Those who were weakened said to those who were arrogant: No, it was a plot of night and day, when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allah and to set up partners to Him. And they concealed repentance when they saw the punishment. And We placed shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they punished for anything other than what they used to do?
34:34: We never sent a warner to any city without its affluent ones saying: Surely we are disbelievers in that with which you have been sent.
34:35: And they said: We have more wealth and children, and we are not among those who will be punished.
34:36: Say: Surely my Rabb expands the provision for whomever He wills and restricts it, but most of the people do not know.
34:37: It is not your wealth or your children that bring you close to Us, but for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there is a manifold reward, and they are secure in high chambers.
34:38: As for those who strive to render Our verses ineffective, they are those who will be brought into the punishment.
34:39: Say: Surely my Rabb expands the provision for whomever He wills of His servants and restricts it for him, and whatever you spend, He replaces it, and He is the Best of providers.
34:40: On that Day He will gather them all, then He will say to the angels: Was it you that these people used to worship?
34:41: They said: Glory be to You! You are our protector, not them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them.
34:42: Today you have power neither to benefit nor to harm one another, and We say to those who did wrong: Taste the punishment of the fire which you were denying.
34:43: When Our verses were recited to them clearly, they said: This is only a man who wants to turn you away from what your fathers were worshipping. And they said: This is only an invented lie. And those who disbelieved said when the truth came to them: This is only clear magic.
34:44: We did not give them a book that they would read, and before you We did not send them a warner.
34:45: Those before them also denied. They could not even attain a tenth of what We had given them. Thus they denied My messengers. How then was My rejection?
34:46: Say: I give you only a single admonition: Stand up for Allah, by twos and singly, then reflect. There is no madness in your companion. He is only a warner for you in the face of a severe punishment.
34:47: Say: If I have asked of you any reward, it is for you. My reward belongs only to Allah. He is witness over all things.
34:48: Say: Surely my Rabb casts the truth; He is the Knower of the unseen realms.
34:49: Say: The truth has come, and falsehood neither begins nor repeats.
34:50: Say: If I go astray, I go astray only against my own self; and if I am rightly guided, this is by virtue of what my Rabb reveals to me.
34:51: If only you could see when they are terrified, then there is no escape, and they have been seized from a near place.
34:52: And they said: We have believed in it. But how could reaching it from a far place be possible for them?
34:53: Whereas they had already denied it before, and they were casting stones at the unseen from a far place.
34:54: And a barrier was placed between them and that which they desired, just as was done with their likes before. Surely they were in doubt.
